task: Connect guarded keyed Granite results from verified prepared pages to queued audits and the existing report API.
nonGoals: No frontend, public contract, production migration, deployment, or account usage/timeout change. No live inference in CI. No private merchant data in Git.

outcomes.description: A keyed-enabled Granite queue consumes verified prepared data, stores one bounded response and normalized question rows, and never resends an uncertain attempt.
outcomes.evidence: Queue delivery, checkpoint and D1 tests.

outcomes.description: The existing report API exposes supported findings and their evidence while withholding a final score with unresolved checks.
One local Faherty queue test uses the default gateway and the existing safeguards.
outcomes.evidence: Persistent local database, report API output, and reconciled gateway usage.

process.description: Record a separate plan, run an independent review and fresh-agent checkpoint continuation, and use the standard PR workflow.
process.evidence: Git history, review, exit artifact and hosted CI.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse the report scorer, guarded transport, prepared parser and queue ownership model.

exitTest.reason: The keyed queue route adds a new checkpoint and publication handoff that must survive independent continuation.
